name: corrcoef
expr: C = corrcoef([1 2 3; 1 2 3]'); r1 = C(1,1); r2 = C(1,2); Cc = corrcoef(Xn,'Rows','complete'); cc12 = Cc(1,2); cc13 = Cc(1,3); Cp = corrcoef(Xn,'Rows','pairwise'); cp13 = Cp(1,3); cp23 = Cp(2,3); xyc = corrcoef([1;2;3;NaN;5],[2;4;6;8;NaN],'Rows','complete'); xyc12 = xyc(1,2);
comment: Sig: r = corrcoef(...[,'Rows',R]). Spec-extension batch 2026-05-09. 2026-05-30: 'Rows' NaN policy added (previously corrcoef ERRORED 'two-input form requires vector arguments' on 'complete'/'pairwise' because the string fell through cov's two-input path, and NaN-poisoned the two-vector form). 'complete' = listwise deletion: cc12=1, cc13=-0.300376. 'pairwise' = pairwise deletion, normalized over each pair's common non-NaN rows (NOT corrcov(cov_partialrows)): cp13=-0.290191 vs cp23=-0.300376. Two-vector 'complete' xyc12=1. 'pairwise' is Pearson-only; [R,P] with 'pairwise' deferred (per-pair df). Matches MATLAB R2025b.
